title: AgentPlatformContracts
description: Generated by scripts/gen_contracts.py. Do not edit.

ActionRecord.description: One executed tool call, as stored in ``agent.step``.
ActionRecord.title: ActionRecord

Actor.description: Who did something. ``id`` is the agent id for agents, absent for system.
Actor.title: Actor

AgentStep.description: One iteration of the agent loop (SPEC §10.1).
AgentStep.title: AgentStep

BoardEntry.description:
A posted entry. ``seq`` equals the ``seq`` of the ``board.entry_posted`` event
that created it, so digest cursors and event cursors share one ordering.
BoardEntry.title: BoardEntry

BoardEntryDraft.description:
What an author submits; the BoardService fills id, seq, author, status, time.

``to`` = ``None`` means everyone; a list of agent ids makes it a direct message.
BoardEntryDraft.title: BoardEntryDraft

Budgets.description: Hard limits for a session. ``None`` means unlimited for the optional ones.
Budgets.title: Budgets

Frame.description: Metadata of one saved screenshot. Bytes live in the ArtifactStore.
Frame.title: Frame

Heartbeat.description: ``agent.heartbeat``: sent every 10 s by a working agent; renews its task lease.
Heartbeat.title: Heartbeat

InputRef.description: Wires an upstream task's output into this task's context.
InputRef.title: InputRef

OutputSpec.description:
One output a task must produce in ``submit_result``.

``kind="artifact"`` outputs are satisfied by an artifact id (string) in
``TaskResult.outputs[key]`` that is also listed in ``TaskResult.artifact_ids``.
``json_schema`` is only meaningful for ``kind="json"``.
OutputSpec.title: OutputSpec

Plan.description: A stored plan version of a session.
Plan.title: Plan

PlanDiff.description: Difference between two proposals, matched by task key (computed by the planner).
PlanDiff.title: PlanDiff

PlanError.description:
One problem found by ``validate_plan``.

``task_key`` is set when the problem belongs to one task (UI shows it on that
node). ``cycle`` holds the cycle path for ``code="cycle"``, first key repeated
at the end, e.g. ``["T1", "T2", "T1"]``.
PlanError.title: PlanError

PlanProposal.description: Planner output (SPEC §11.1), also the stored body of every plan version.
PlanProposal.title: PlanProposal

PlanSessionCommand.description: Run the planner for a newly created session.
PlanSessionCommand.title: PlanSessionCommand

PostBoardCommand.description: A user board post (kinds note/decision/answer, checked by the API).
PostBoardCommand.title: PostBoardCommand

ProblemError.description: One structured error inside a problem response (field or plan error).
ProblemError.title: ProblemError

SandboxRef.description: Enough to reconnect to a sandbox after a runtime restart (no secrets).
SandboxRef.title: SandboxRef

SessionPlanProposed.description: The planner produced a proposal. It becomes plan ``plan_version``.
SessionPlanProposed.title: SessionPlanProposed

SessionPlanUpdated.description:
A plan version was stored that did not come from the planner (user edit via
``PUT /plan`` or a supervisor plan change).
SessionPlanUpdated.title: SessionPlanUpdated

SessionPlanningFailed.description:
The planner failed after its repair attempt. The session stays in ``planning``
(status unchanged) so the user can retry or edit; ``errors`` are PlanError dumps.
SessionPlanningFailed.title: SessionPlanningFailed

Task.description: A task in a session's plan, with runtime state.
Task.title: Task

TaskCounts.description: Number of tasks per status; statuses with zero tasks may be omitted.
TaskCounts.title: TaskCounts

TaskDraft.description:
A task without runtime fields, as produced by the planner or edited by the user.

Structural rules that span tasks (unique keys, known dependencies, no cycles,
1..6 criteria, inputs wired to existing outputs) are checked by
``contracts.plan.validate_plan`` so they can be reported per task.
TaskDraft.title: TaskDraft

TaskUpdated.description: Full snapshot of a task after a change, plus the names of changed fields.
TaskUpdated.title: TaskUpdated

Thumbnail.description: Latest small screenshot of an agent for live tiles (JPEG, base64).
Thumbnail.title: Thumbnail

UpdatePlanCommand.description: Store a user-edited plan (already validated by the API) as a new plan version.
UpdatePlanCommand.title: UpdatePlanCommand

Usage.description: Accumulated usage of a session (or a single step, in ``agent.step``).
Usage.title: Usage

UserSteer.description:
A steering message. ``agent_id=None`` addresses every agent and the supervisor.
``entry_id`` is the board note that carries it into digests.
UserSteer.title: UserSteer

WsTicket.description:
A single-use ticket for ``WS /ws/sessions/{id}?ticket=<ticket>``.

Bound to the session it was issued for, valid for ``ttl_s`` seconds, consumed by
the first WebSocket handshake that presents it. Lets the browser authenticate the
WebSocket without putting the API token in a URL.
WsTicket.title: WsTicket

WsTicketRequest.description: Body of ``POST /sessions/{id}/ws-ticket``. Empty today; the body is optional.
WsTicketRequest.title: WsTicketRequest
